verdicts.observation: 固定commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，tome组件 game/modules/tome/data/zones/dreadfell/npcs.lua：define_as=PALE_DRAKE，name=Pale Drake，type=undead subtype=skeleton，desc=A malevolent skeleton archmage；亡灵已由type表达，Pale是专名修饰（苍白）。译文「亡灵德瑞克」把Pale改成种族类别亡灵。

固定commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/temple-of-creation/objects.lua LEGACY_NALOREN：imbued with the greatest strengths of … Naga warriors；hope for all of the Naloren race, that one outside of their tribe could be so trusted。chats/slasul.lua：When Nalore sank…cursed in this form，Naga为现形态、Naloren为族裔。译文「娜迦即纳鲁精灵一族」合并两专名；「只有你能受到他们如此的信任」删掉部落外人可被信任这一关系。

固定commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/shertul-fortress/npcs.lua WEIRDLING_BEAST：name=Weirdling Beast unique，desc=A roughly humanoid creature, with tentacle-like appendages…no head。quests/shertul-fortress.lua 于spawn_butler发放该成就。译文「异形触手」把具名人形horror Boss降成触手。信封术语Yiilkgur→伊克格已用，但notes称夏·图尔要塞，译文作堡垒。

固定commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/keepsake-meadow/npcs.lua define_as=KYLESS name=Kyless unique type=humanoid subtype=human；quests/keepsake.lua：Kyless, the one who brought the curse。译文「克里斯」是Chris的常规音译，与专名Kyless不符。

固定commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/init.lua load_tips：its creations have plagued all the races since the earliest memories。译文「它的出现在最初的岁月里给所有种族带来了非常的劫难」把creations（死灵造物）改成这门艺术的出现。
